description: API-shape experiment for session scenes and clip slots stored in the song separately from the arrangement. Expectations describe behaviour, not names.

tasks.prompt: A browser groovebox has an empty song as `project` (4/4, 120 BPM) and its running engine as `workspace`. The song has three tracks: Drums and Bass (MIDI, each with a sound already set up) and Loop (audio). Write the code that builds a session grid of four scenes named Intro, Verse, Chorus and Outro. Each scene has its own clips on each track, made in code: one-bar MIDI patterns for Drums and Bass, and for Loop an audio clip from a given 2-second AudioBuffer `loopBuffer` that loops. Leave Bass empty in Intro. These clips live only in the session grid: the arrangement timeline stays empty, and nothing plays from it. Add buttons that launch each scene on the next bar, and a Stop button. A track with an empty slot in a launched scene stops. Save the song to a `.dawproject` Blob and open it again: the four scenes, their names and every slot's clip come back.
expectations: Creates four named scenes whose clips belong to the session grid, not to the arrangement timeline.
Puts one-bar MIDI patterns in the Drums and Bass slots and a looping audio clip in the Loop slots, leaving Bass empty in Intro.
Scene buttons launch a whole scene on the next bar through the engine, and Stop stops the session.
A track whose slot is empty in the launched scene stops instead of continuing its previous clip.
The arrangement timeline stays empty and silent.
Scenes, names and slot clips survive saving and reopening.

checks.label: No arrangement clips used as slots, no hand-rolled launcher

tasks.prompt: A browser DAW has an open song as `project` and its running engine as `workspace`. The song has a session grid of scenes and clip slots (separate from the arrangement). Write the code for these session edits, each one Undo step: rename scene 2 to "Drop"; move the clip in slot (track "Bass", scene 1) to (track "Bass", scene 3); duplicate the whole of scene 2 as a new scene right after it; delete the clip in slot (track "Drums", scene 4) so that slot is empty; and copy the clip in slot (track "Keys", scene 2) onto the arrangement timeline at bar 9. Then list the grid: for every scene, its name and, per track, the name and length of the clip in its slot or "empty".
tasks.hostDeclarations:
declare const project: import("@audiorective/daw").Project;
declare const workspace: import("@audiorective/daw").Workspace;
expectations: Renames a scene through the song model.
Moves a slot's clip to another scene on the same track.
Duplicates a whole scene right after the original, copying its slot clips.
Empties a slot by removing its clip.
Copies a slot clip onto the arrangement timeline at bar 9 without removing it from the slot.
Each edit is one undoable step, and the listing reads scenes and slots from the song model.

checks.label: Reads the grid from the model, not from launcher internals or DOM
